title: Adaptive Contrast Ring
description: Adaptive Contrast Ring is a interface ability in the Dynamic Focus Rings database. Picks a ring color that contrasts with whatever is behind it. The pixels under the ring are sampled and the ring color is chosen for maximum contrast. It takes background pixels and produces contrasting ring. Tunable parameters: WCAG AA. Guarantee: the ring is never invisible.

fields.mechanism: The pixels under the ring are sampled and the ring color is chosen for maximum contrast.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Keyboard Focus Trail
description: Keyboard Focus Trail is a interface ability in the Dynamic Focus Rings database. Leaves a brief trail showing where keyboard focus just traveled. Focus changes draw a fading line from the old element to the new one over 250 ms. It takes focus events and produces trail. Tunable parameters: 250 ms fade. Guarantee: trails never persist.

fields.mechanism: Focus changes draw a fading line from the old element to the new one over 250 ms.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Group Focus Halo
description: Group Focus Halo is a interface ability in the Dynamic Focus Rings database. Rings a whole group when focus lands anywhere inside it. Focus within a group draws the halo around the group's bounding box instead of the element. It takes group bounds and produces halo. Tunable parameters: bounding box. Guarantee: the halo never covers group content.

fields.mechanism: Focus within a group draws the halo around the group's bounding box instead of the element.
fields.guarantees: the halo never covers group content

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Urgency Pulsing
description: Urgency Pulsing is a interface ability in the Dynamic Focus Rings database. Pulses the ring faster when the focused item needs attention. An urgency score 0–1 maps to pulse rate; critical items pulse at 3 Hz with a red tint. It takes urgency score and produces pulsing ring. Tunable parameters: 0.5–3 Hz. Guarantee: the pulse never exceeds 4 Hz.

fields.mechanism: An urgency score 0–1 maps to pulse rate; critical items pulse at 3 Hz with a red tint.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Focus Memory
description: Focus Memory is a interface ability in the Dynamic Focus Rings database. Returns focus to the last-focused element after a dialog closes. The previously focused element is stored on dialog open and restored on close. It takes dialog events and produces restored focus. Tunable parameters: exact element. Guarantee: focus is never left on the body.

fields.mechanism: The previously focused element is stored on dialog open and restored on close.
fields.guarantees: focus is never left on the body

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Screen-Reader Sync
description: Screen-Reader Sync is a interface ability in the Dynamic Focus Rings database. Keeps the visual ring in sync with the screen reader's virtual cursor. Virtual cursor moves are mirrored to the ring position through the accessibility API. It takes AT events and produces synced ring. Tunable parameters: mirror. Guarantee: the ring never fights the AT.

fields.mechanism: Virtual cursor moves are mirrored to the ring position through the accessibility API.
fields.guarantees: the ring never fights the AT

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Touch Focus Ring
description: Touch Focus Ring is a interface ability in the Dynamic Focus Rings database. Shows a larger ring for touch focus that fades after lift. Touch targets get a 44 px minimum ring that fades 1 second after the touch ends. It takes touch events and produces touch ring. Tunable parameters: 44 px min. Guarantee: the ring never blocks the touch.

fields.mechanism: Touch targets get a 44 px minimum ring that fades 1 second after the touch ends.
fields.guarantees: the ring never blocks the touch

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Focus Within Dim
description: Focus Within Dim is a interface ability in the Dynamic Focus Rings database. Dims the page slightly outside the focused region for deep focus. A translucent overlay with a cutout at the focused element fades in over 400 ms. It takes focused element and produces spotlight. Tunable parameters: 400 ms fade. Guarantee: the overlay never intercepts clicks.

fields.mechanism: A translucent overlay with a cutout at the focused element fades in over 400 ms.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Multi-Focus Rings
description: Multi-Focus Rings is a interface ability in the Dynamic Focus Rings database. Shows one ring per user in collaborative editing. Each user's focus renders in their color with their name; rings never merge. It takes user focus streams and produces colored rings. Tunable parameters: per-user. Guarantee: rings always match user colors.

fields.mechanism: Each user's focus renders in their color with their name; rings never merge.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Focus History Bar
description: Focus History Bar is a interface ability in the Dynamic Focus Rings database. Keeps a scrubable history of where focus has been. Focus events append to a timeline; clicking an entry returns focus there. It takes focus log and produces history bar. Tunable parameters: per session. Guarantee: history never records passwords.

fields.mechanism: Focus events append to a timeline; clicking an entry returns focus there.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Error Ring
description: Error Ring is a interface ability in the Dynamic Focus Rings database. Turns the ring red and shakes it gently on validation errors. Failed validation triggers the error style on the field's ring until the error clears. It takes validation events and produces error ring. Tunable parameters: shake 200 ms. Guarantee: the ring always returns to normal on fix.

fields.mechanism: Failed validation triggers the error style on the field's ring until the error clears.
fields.guarantees: the ring always returns to normal on fix

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Skip-Link Ring
description: Skip-Link Ring is a interface ability in the Dynamic Focus Rings database. Highlights skip links strongly when they receive focus. Skip links get a high-contrast ring style so keyboard users can see them instantly. It takes skip link focus and produces strong ring. Tunable parameters: always visible. Guarantee: skip links are never hidden when focused.

fields.mechanism: Skip links get a high-contrast ring style so keyboard users can see them instantly.
fields.guarantees: skip links are never hidden when focused

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Focus Trap Indicator
description: Focus Trap Indicator is a interface ability in the Dynamic Focus Rings database. Shows a subtle boundary when focus is trapped in a modal. While trapped, the ring style changes at the trap edges to signal the boundary. It takes modal state and produces trap styling. Tunable parameters: subtle. Guarantee: the trap always releases on close.

fields.mechanism: While trapped, the ring style changes at the trap edges to signal the boundary.
fields.guarantees: the trap always releases on close

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Reduced-Motion Ring
description: Reduced-Motion Ring is a interface ability in the Dynamic Focus Rings database. Replaces pulsing with a static high-contrast ring when reduced motion is set. The media query is respected; all animation on the ring is disabled. It takes prefers-reduced-motion and produces static ring. Tunable parameters: no animation. Guarantee: motion is never forced.

fields.mechanism: The media query is respected; all animation on the ring is disabled.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Ring Theming API
description: Ring Theming API is a interface ability in the Dynamic Focus Rings database. Lets themes restyle the ring through CSS variables. Ring color, width, and style read from --focus-ring-* variables with sensible defaults. It takes theme CSS and produces themed ring. Tunable parameters: CSS vars. Guarantee: defaults always meet contrast.

fields.mechanism: Ring color, width, and style read from --focus-ring-* variables with sensible defaults.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.
